_comment: Source files behind developers/object-model facts that are read from source rather than diffed (sync-object-model-docs skill). Each source pins the sha256 of `git show <ref>:<path>` in the sibling checkout (<repo> relative to the speckle-atlas root; `.` is the root itself; ref defaults to origin/main) as of the last time a conclusion was verified against it. check-object-model-freshness.mjs reports sources whose hash moved. Refresh sha256, verifiedAt and the note whenever you re-verify.
